analysis.reasonEn: RSI moved from 46.3 to 54.4, exiting oversold and settling in neutral. MACD histogram worsened from -0.8221 to -1.1868, but weekly ADX at 29.5 indicates a clear trend. The 5-day low of $186.15 is higher than the 20-day low of $184.45, forming a Higher Low pattern. Current price $196.75 is above SMA20 $195.51, confirming support. Volume ratio of 0.69 shows subdued activity, reducing confidence. Position at 84.8% of 52-week range near highs. Holding for 15 consecutive days. Market sentiment is negative (80% negative factors), but technical indicators are exploring direction in the neutral zone.
